The *Kusalattika* (Patthana 13.1) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final book of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The text constitutes a section within the *Paṭṭhāna*'s analytical framework investigating conditional relations based on the triad of wholesome (*kusala*), unwholesome (*akusala*), and indeterminate (*abyākata*) dhammas [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral lists no English title, translations, or curated historical parallels for this individual entry [SuttaCentral].
